correction_reason: Law #165 fetch-and-confirm review found the sent VOs/hooks for both packages contained inaccurate core claims: HxH overclaimed 'ten chapters fully written' (verified: 3 chapters finished, 421-423, with progress toward 430); Bleach undercounted returning characters at 'three' (verified: four -- Harribel, Nelliel, Pesche, Dondochakka) and asserted a fabricated 'assumed gone for good' stakes framing with no source support. This is an internal/production-record correction only -- batch 714d87e0 was never committed to GitHub or logged as a confirmed production send; only the two Outlook emails went out.
